subject: storytime
title: Goodnight Moon words
about: A little rabbit lies in a big green bedroom and says goodnight to each thing in it, from the moon in the window to the mittens and the mouse, as the room slowly grows dark. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together at bedtime, with him finding each thing in the picture.

book.author: Margaret Wise Brown
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A sleepy rabbit's bedtime list, read by families for more than seventy years.

passage.text:
goodnight rabbit moon cow
room light balloon bears
kittens clock mittens socks
mouse comb brush bowl
stars quiet
